guidance.label: Draft — not submitted
guidance.description: Complete and save your questionnaire and required document links, then review and submit.

guidance.label: Submitted — awaiting screening
guidance.description: Your submitted copy is saved for review. You do not need to submit another copy unless corrections are requested.

guidance.label: Under staff review
guidance.description: Authorized staff are reviewing your current submission. Any requested corrections and applicant-facing updates will appear in your history.

guidance.label: Corrections requested
guidance.description: Read the requested changes, update your correction copy, save and resubmit.

guidance.label: Corrections submitted — awaiting screening
guidance.description: Your revised copy has been sent. Earlier submissions remain preserved.

guidance.label: Approved — demonstration only
guidance.description: The Director approved this submitted revision for the demonstration. This does not issue a certificate. Check the issuance-request workspace for availability.

guidance.label: Rejected — demonstration only
guidance.description: Read the final decision summary in your history. No demonstration-document request is available from this rejected decision.

guidance.label: Status unavailable
guidance.description: Open the application history for the available details.

scope: Metadata and source contracts only; no actual permission evaluation.
